items.question: Who are Kalani Brown's parents?
items.answer: Kalani Brown is the daughter of DeJuna (Dee) Brown and former NBA veteran P.J. Brown. Both of her parents played basketball at Louisiana Tech. She has two sisters, Briana and Whitney, and a brother, Javani.

items.question: Which teams has Kalani Brown played for?
items.answer: Kalani Brown has played for the Los Angeles Sparks, Atlanta Dream, Dallas Wings, Phoenix Mercury and Las Vegas Aces.

items.question: Where did Kalani Brown play college basketball?
items.answer: Kalani Brown played at Baylor from 2015 to 2019 and won the 2019 NCAA championship. Her career .639 field goal percentage is the highest in Baylor history.

items.question: When was Kalani Brown drafted?
items.answer: The Los Angeles Sparks selected Kalani Brown seventh overall in the 2019 WNBA Draft.
